newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-ROBERTSON DROPPED FOR BREACHING DRINK RULE.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-ROBERTSON DROPPED FOR BREACHING DRINK RULE.

text.p: Nathan Robertson, 19, has been dropped from the England badminton squad for two international events in October for breaching coach Steve Baddeley's tough new rules on drinking.
Robertson, who was earlier this week named in the England party to meet China in November, was caught by Baddeley drinking alcohol at a tournament in Perth last weekend.
Robertson is the first international to fall foul of a tough new training regime brought in by Baddeley as part of his long term plan to improve England's performance at major tournaments.
